questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (5, -2) in the line x = -1?
questions.solution:
Reflection of point about x = -1 can be given as

Since we know that the Y co-ordinate will not change

And the X coordinate can be given as given

X coordinate + 2 × (X coordinate of line – given X coordinate)

⇒ 5 + 2 × {-1 – (5)} = -7

∴ the coordinate of reflection is (-7, -2)

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of R and S is 11 : 17. Before 11 years, the ratio of their ages was 11 ∶ 20. What is R's present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
Let the present age of R be r and S be s

According to the problem statement

⇒ r/s = 11/17

⇒ s = 17r/11 ----(1)

According to the problem statement 11 years ago,

⇒ (r - 11)/(s - 11) = 11/20

⇒ 20r - 220 = 11s - 121 Using (1)

⇒ 20r - 17r = 99

⇒ r = 99/3 = 33

∴ R’s present age is 33 years

questions.question: A number is increased by 84, it becomes 107% of itself. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be y According to the problem statement

⇒ y + 84 = 107 x y/100

⇒ 84 = 1.07y – y = 0.07y

⇒ y = 1200

∴ the number is 1200

questions.question: An amount fetched a total simple interest of Rs. 3200 at the rate of 6.25% per year in 4 years. What is the amount (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Let the amount be y

Simple Interest can be given as

⇒ 3200 = (y × 6.25 × 4)/100

⇒ y = 12800

∴ the amount is Rs. 12800

questions.question: If the cost of total spending on transport for the seminar was Rs. 9 lakhs and the cost of hosting the students was Rs. 15000 per student then what was the ratio of hosting cost of all the students to that of spending on transport?
questions.solution:
Given that total spending on transport was Rs. 9 lakh

Total number of students can be given as

⇒ total = 25 + 30 + 15 + 5 + 10 + 5 = 90

⇒ total spending on hosting = 90 × 15000 = 1350000

Ratio of hosting cost of all the students to that of spending on transport can be given as

⇒ ratio = 1350000/900000 = 3/2

∴ Required ratio is 3 : 2

questions.question: The average marks of 40 students in an examination was 25. It was later found that the marks of one student had been wrongly entered as 73 instead of 37. What is the value of correct average?
questions.solution:
Given that average marks of 40 students is 25

⇒ Sum of marks of 40 students/40 = 25

⇒ sum of marks of students = 40 × 25 = 1000

According to the problem statement, correct average can be given as

⇒ (1000 – 73 + 37)/40 = 964/40 = 24.1

∴ the correct average marks are 24.1

questions.question: If a boat goes a certain distance at 30 km/hr and comes back the same distance at 60 km/hr. What is the average speed (in km/hr) for the total journey?
questions.solution:
Let the distance be d km

Total time required can be given as

⇒ d/30 + d/60 = d/20

Average speed can be given as total distance/total time

⇒ 2d/(d/20) = 40 km/hr

∴ the average speed is 40 km/hr

questions.question: What is the sum of the first 9 terms of an arithmetic progression if the first term is 7 and last term is 55?
questions.solution:
Sum of first 9 terms can be given as

⇒ sum = 9(7 + 55)/2 = 9 × 31 = 279

∴ the sum of first 9 terms is 279

questions.question: What is the slope of the line parallel to the line passing through the points (5, -1) and (4, -4)?
questions.solution:
Since we know that the slope of line parallel to the given line is same as that of given line

⇒ Slope = {-4 – (-1)}/{4 – 5} = -3/-1 = 3

∴ the slope of the line parallel to the given line is 3

questions.solution:
For this to be divisible by 11, sum of numbers at even places - sum of numbers at odd places must be zero or divisible by 11

⇒ (4 + 1) - (3 + 0) = 5 - 3 = 2

instead of 2 there must be 0, so that it will be divisible by 11

questions.question: A fraction is greater than its reciprocal by 9/20. What is the fraction?
questions.solution:
Let the fraction be y

According to the problem statement

⇒ y – 1/y = 9/20

⇒ 20y² – 9y – 20 = 0

⇒ y² - (9)/(20)y - 1 = 0

⇒ y² +(4)/(5)y -(5)/(4)y - 1 =0

⇒ y(y + 4/5) - 5/4(y + 4/5) = 0

⇒ (y – 5/4)(y + 4/5) = 0

⇒ y = 5/4 or y = -4/5

∴ The fraction is 5/4.

questions.question: Point A divides segment BC in the ratio 4 : 1. Co - ordinates of B are (6, 1) and C are (7/2, 6). What are the coordinates of point A?
questions.solution:
X coordinate of A can be given as, Using Section formulae

⇒ X coordinate of A = {4 × (7/2) + 1 × 6}/(4 + 1) = 4

Y coordinate of A can be given as, Using Section formulae

⇒ Y coordinate of A = {4 × (6) + 1 × 1}/(4 + 1) = 5

∴ Coordinates of point A are (4, 5)

questions.question: By what count (in %) students from Country B at the seminar were more than the students from Country E?
questions.solution:
Students from E = 10

Students from B = 30

⇒ Difference between them = 30 – 10 = 20

⇒ Percentage = 20 × 100/10 = 200%

∴ Country B is having 200% more students than country E

questions.question: ∆XYZ is similar to ∆PQR. If the ratio of Perimeter of ∆XYZ and Perimeter of ∆PQR is 16 : 9 and PQ = 3.6 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of XY?
questions.solution:
Since we know that ratio of perimeters of two triangles is same as that of sides

⇒ Perimeter of ∆XYZ/Perimeter of ∆PQR = 16/9 = XY/PQ

⇒ XY = 16 × 3.6/9 = 6.4 cm

∴ XY is 6.4 cm

questions.question: If a³ + b³ = 152 and a + b = 8, then what is the value of ab?
questions.solution:
Given a + b = 8, Cubing both sides

⇒ (a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab (a + b) ,

Using given data

⇒ 8³ = 152 + 3ab × (8)

⇒ (512 – 152)/24 = ab

⇒ ab = 15

∴ the value of ab is 15

questions.question: What is the value of (1/2) Sec 30° + √2 tan 60°?
questions.solution:
Since we know that sec 30 = 2/√3 and tan 60 = √3, put this in the required equation

⇒ (½) Sec 30° + √2 tan 60°

⇒ (1/2) × 2/√3 + (√2) × (√3) = (1 + 3√2)/√3

∴ the value of (1/2) Sec 30° + √2 Tan 60° is (1 + 3√2)/√3

questions.question: A wholesaler sells a jacket to a retailer at a profit of 5% and the retailer sells it to a customer at a profit of 10%. If the customer pays Rs. 4158, what had it cost (in Rs) to the wholesaler?
questions.solution:
Let the y be the cost at which wholesaler had bought

According to the problem statement

⇒ y × (1 + 5/100) × (1 + 10/100) = 4158

⇒ y × 1.05 × 1.1 = 4158

⇒ y = 4158/(1.1 × 1.05) = 3600

∴ the cost at which wholesaler had bought is Rs. 3600

questions.question: What is the area (in sq cm) of a regular hexagon of side 14 cm?
questions.solution:
Area of hexagon is equivalent to 6 times the area of each equilateral triangle of side 14 cm

⇒ Area of hexagon = √3 × (14)² × 6/4 = 294√3

∴ the area of hexagon is 294√3 cm²

questions.question: M is thrice as good as workman as N and together they finish a piece of work in 30 days. In how many days will M alone finish the work?
questions.solution:
Let the work done by M in 1 day be y of the total work

Since M is thrice as good as N

⇒ Work done by N in 1 day be y/3 of the total work

According to the problem statement

⇒ 30(y + y/3) = 1

⇒ 4y/3 = 1/30

⇒ y = 1/40

This shows that the M can do the whole work in 40 days alone

∴ Number of days required by M to work alone are 40 days
